items.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
items.snippet: Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore, the Singapore government's technology agency, announced a new AI tool to protect citizens from scams. According to the Google DeepMind blog, the tool uses a lightweight Gemma model running on the device to filter out conversational scams in private chats. No data is sent to the cloud.

items.title: AI Models May Soon Self-Replicate Across Smart-Home Devices, Anthropic Warns
items.snippet: Anthropic said small AI models could be months away from self-replicating across internet-connected devices, raising the possibility of AI botnets spreading quickly, fighting takedown attempts and even breaking into data centers to turbocharge their growth. The company said that its experiments showed that a malicious AI agent could stitch together the computing power of inexpensive internet-connected devices to run other AI models.

items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.snippet: At Anthropic, coding is no longer the bottleneck to building systems or doing research. We built Scion, an in-house version control system, and fully migrated our monorepo from git in five months. Claude's ability to write code was both what put us in this situation in the first place and how we were able to quickly build a high-quality, scalable system to deal with it.

items.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
items.snippet: A new study with Arizona State University (ASU) shows that when students ask questions of an AI tutor, their learning outcomes improve significantly. We believe AI can act as a powerful tool to foster deeper student inquiry and critical thinking skills. This research explores how AI-powered tutors can encourage students to develop better question-asking habits and engage more deeply with course material.

items.title: HiRO-ACEv2: Simulating extreme weather at 3 km resolution for a fraction of the cost
items.snippet: We introduce HiRO-ACEv2, the newest update to our High Resolution Output Ai2 Climate Emulator (HiRO-ACE) system. HiROv2 can reproduce even extremely rare rain, wind, and pressure events with high accuracy, while the full system can generate global 3 km climate data at about 1/300th the cost of X-SHiELD, making detailed global climate simulations more accessible to researchers.

items.title: Introducing Llama Windows: llama.cpp in your Windows tray
items.snippet: Llama Windows is a free, open source desktop app that brings the llama.cpp local AI inferencing library to Windows 11, similar to the llama.app on Mac. With Llama Windows, you can pick a model from the Hugging Face Hub, download it in one click, and run it locally from the notification area. No terminal, no build step, no admin rights.

items.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-Base-BF16
items.snippet: The model combines interleaved Mamba-2, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and attention layers with a C-RADIO vision encoder and a vision-language connector. It has 120B total parameters and 12B active parameters and supports context lengths up to 1M tokens. This model is intended for developers and researchers building custom vision-language models through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

dropped.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
dropped.snippet: Gemini 4 Argon marks a step change in physical understanding, code generation, and visual-semantic reasoning—unlocking new workflows across the robotics stack and accelerating progress toward physical AGI. As a general-purpose physical reasoning model, Argon can be applied across the entire robotics lifecycle. Argon bridges coding, visual perception, physics simulation, and embodied robot control.

dropped.title: Developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely
dropped.snippet: Safety and security are foundational to model development at Google. Because Argon is a highly capable model, we collaborated with a variety of third-party partners on measurement of certain model capabilities and safeguards. Gemini 4 Argon represents our most comprehensive safety and security stack yet: Misuse & jailbreak defenses.

dropped.title: We're powering European scientific discovery with advanced AI compute and frontier models.
dropped.snippet: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud are providing up to 200 top European scientific researchers with direct access to our frontier models, together with $3 million in compute credits. Through this pledge, researchers will gain direct access to our leading scientific tools including AlphaFold 3, WeatherNext, AlphaGenome, AlphaEvolve, and AlphaEarth Foundations. This commitment supports the European Union's AI for Science work by making some of our frontier models available via the RAISE initiative.

dropped.title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
dropped.snippet: Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards, which described how we measure and prevent political bias, detect misuse, and direct people to accurate voting information. Political, state-aligned, and commercial actors are now incorporating AI into nearly every aspect of their influence operations, from planning and content creation to building platforms used to disseminate a message.

dropped.title: Welcome FLUX.3 Image Klein in Diffusers
dropped.snippet: We are excited to announce the release of FLUX.3 Image Klein in Diffusers, a new model that pushes the boundaries of image generation. This model offers enhanced capabilities for creating high-quality, diverse images with fine-grained control, making it a valuable tool for researchers and creators in the diffusion models space. It integrates seamlessly into the Diffusers library, allowing for easy experimentation and deployment.

dropped.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
dropped.snippet: AWS says the main thing blocking enterprise AI agents is trust, not capability, and it has a name for its answer: Trust in Depth. We propose four independent layers instead: scope, know, bound and observe. Organizations need the confidence to hand an AI agent important work, knowing it will stay within the limits set, even when no one is watching.

dropped.title: AI-Facilitated Discovery of Microbiome-Originated Antimicrobial Peptides: A Perspective on Combating Antibiotic Resistance Within Public Health and Food Safety Frameworks
dropped.snippet: The escalating crisis of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) demands innovative therapeutic strategies beyond conventional antibiotics. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have revolutionized the discovery pipeline, enabling high-throughput mining of metagenomic data and de novo generation of novel peptide sequences. Antimicrobial peptides, particularly those originating from the human, animal, and environmental microbiome, represent a promising frontier within public health microbiology and microbial food safety.
